This seeds is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in freshwater banks and shores, and is best known in western Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it is consumed directly.

In good and honest beings, the seeds inspire confidence and determination (+25) for 1–4 hours; in evil creatures or those bound to Darkness they cause dizziness and confusion (−50).
